hints.title: Elimination Invariant
hints.text: Every match eliminates exactly one team from the tournament.

hints.title: Single Winner Outcome
hints.text: In a single-elimination tournament, exactly n - 1 teams must be eliminated to declare one champion.

hints.title: Direct Arithmetic
hints.text: The total number of matches played is always n - 1.
